title: o9bd.9.1 Choice schema + choice-coverage audit gate + unsupportedChoice marker (framework)
description: Foundational slice of the choice-modeling sub-epic. Add a structured 'choices' field to feature records (id, category, prompt, choose, from?, level, optional unsupportedChoice named marker), a 'choice-coverage' gate in srdPlayabilityAudit.ts that flags level-1/level-up player choices that are prose-only (feature granted by a class progression row whose description carries build-choice signals but lacks structured choices / an unsupportedChoice marker), and the named-unsupported-marker convention. Include ONE worked modeled example (Fighter Fighting Style) to exercise the green path end-to-end (schema + parser + emit + regen + gate-green for that feature). Gate lands RED as a punch list for the remaining slices. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Labels: importer, srd, thaw.
notes: Scope landed as PURE FRAMEWORK (no pack regeneration): feature.data.choices[] schema + reusable validator, shared closed category vocabulary (featureChoices.ts), named unsupported-marker convention, and the choice-coverage audit gate. Gate is RED on the committed pack with a 48-finding punch list bucketed per slice: .9.2 subclass(12), .9.3 spell/cantrip(12), .9.4 ASI-vs-feat(12), .9.5 fighting-style/metamagic/invocation/terrain-enemy(7), .9.6 channel-divinity/expertise(5). Subclass coverage is checked structurally per-class (selector prose varies too much); other categories via SRD-phrasing-tuned heuristics; ranger foe-slayer/primeval-awareness false positives excluded. Green path proven via synthetic records in unit tests rather than a real Fighting Style parse, to decouple the framework from the fragile PDF feature parser — real per-type modeling (incl. Fighter Fighting Style) lands in the slices. No importer behavior change; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack byte-stable.
